{"id":"3c44c57a590c81028a5ff4a974c9240d","title":"⚖️ 07-14 Interaction Conflict / Multi-Operation Intent Integration Contract v0.1","text":"Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3c44c57a590c81028a5ff4a974c9240d as of 2026-08-22T17:16:55.830Z: {"title":"07-14 Interaction Conflict / Multi-Operation Intent Integration Contract v0.1"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"⚖️"} Status: Proposed Freeze — Interaction Conflict Boundary / Multi-Operation Intent Orchestration Contract. 本页承接 07-09 暴露的 remote Operation vs active InteractionSession、SPECIAL-MULTIOP-01 与 Lifecycle active-session interruption GAP。本文不引入新的 canonical Transaction、不改变 15 类 Operation vocabulary，也不定义 CRDT/OT；它冻结的是：canonical change 到来后谁判断 session stale、谁可以 re-resolve/rebase/cancel、final current-state validation 在哪里发生，以及一个 coherent user intent 跨多个 Operations 时如何 preflight、短临界区执行、失败 containment 与 compensation。 # 0. Authority / Scope 直接 authority： - — InteractionSession transient boundary、StartContext、一个 intent 可产生多个 Operations、Cancel vs Undo。 - — InteractionSessionManager、semanticGenerationAtBegin、Semantic ChangeSet notification、OperationSubmitPort、remote-active-session policy此前 OPEN。 - — TextEditSession / EditorProjection、composition transient、stale projection → Resyncing。 - — whole-operation validation、单 Operation atomicity、no partial apply、15 类 Operation。 - — one intent → 1..N Operations、UndoIntent local-only、multi-op failure OPFLOW GAP。 - — Special Flow stress test；remote-vs-active 与 multi-op intent failure此前保持 OPEN。 - — SemanticGeneration / ChangeSet / ApplyBatchResult；batch mixed outcomes legal；batch 不是 Transaction。 - — App / Canvas / Document / Surface / Sync lifecycle 分离；active session interruption此前 OPEN。 - — remote persist-first → ordered canonical apply → ChangeSet / no echo。 本文冻结 integration ownership、conflict framework、preflight/admission/failure containment、lifecycle baseline。本文不冻结： - Transform 同目标并发时采用 absolute-wins、relative-delta rebase、server-order 或其他产品 semantics； - RichText 同对象并发编辑的 CRDT/OT/merge algorithm； - Connector referential conflict 的最终 collaboration policy； - public C ABI exact struct / symbol names； - UndoIntent durable storage； - 跨客户端“整个 user intent 原子可见”的协议语义。 # 1. Core Invariants IC-INV-01 — Active Session Has No Canonical Veto. active InteractionSession / TransformSession / TextEditSession 不能阻塞、拒绝或重排已经 order-qualified 的 Remote/other-canvas canonical Operation。Remote apply 先按正常 ordered lane 完成；session 在 post-commit ChangeSet 后处理 stale/conflict。 IC-INV-02 — Conflict Resolution Is Transient. Continue / ReResolve / Rebase / Cancel 都只修改 Interaction/Editor transient state；它们本身不写 SemanticDocument、不生成隐藏 Operation。只有用户最终 commit/显式 compensation 才进入 canonical path。 IC-INV-03 — Generation Is a Trigger, Not Conflict Meaning. semanticGenerationAtBegin != currentGeneration 只说明“期间发生过 canonical change”，不等于一定冲突。真正冲突由 session 的 semantic dependency footprint 与 post-commit ChangeSet 相交判断。 IC-INV-04 — OperationEngine Is Final Authority. Interaction preflight/rebase 决不能替代 OperationEngine 的 current-state whole-op validation。任何 stale candidate 最终仍可被 Rejected；OperationEngine 不自动猜测/重写用户 intent。 IC-INV-05 — No Global Transaction. IntentPlan / IntentCommitSegment / UndoIntent / ApplyBatchResult 都不是 canonical Transaction。每个 Operation 仍独立形成自己的 SemanticGeneration / CanonicalCommitStamp / ChangeSet / local publication。 IC-INV-06 — No Auto-Commit on Interruption. Background / Suspend / detach / destroy 不允许把最后一帧 preview、未提交 transform、未完成 eraser sweep 或 IME composing text“猜成”canonical commit。若 Operation 已被 Ordered Runtime 接受进入 atomic apply，则允许该 Operation 正常完成；否则 uncommitted transient state 走 cancel/end。 # 2. Ownership — Who Decides What
Responsibility Owner Must not do
Remote ordering / durable inbound / dispatch Shared Data Runtime 等待 active gesture 决定 remote 能否 apply
Canonical validate / idempotency / atomic apply Axiom OperationEngine 根据 pointer/preview/IME 自动 rebase intent
Post-commit conflict notification Semantic Core → Interaction Runtime 让 session veto 已完成 commit
Session dependency footprint / stale classification InteractionSessionManager + session type 修改 SemanticDocument
ReResolve / Rebase / Cancel Concrete InteractionSession 产生不可见 semantic mutation
Multi-op user-intent grouping / failure policy Editor Intent Coordinator / History boundary 把 UndoIntent 写进 Operation wire
Sequence semantic preflight OperationEngine semantic validation reused by Intent Coordinator 复制第二套 validator
Compensating canonical mutations OperationEngine, source=local compensation/control 内存指针回滚已 committed state
Lifecycle interruption barrier InteractionRuntime + Platform Lifecycle control 因为 surface lost 直接 reload Document
# 3. Two-Layer Conflict Defense 冲突防护分成主动 session 层与最终 semantic 层： ```txt Canonical Commit from any source → ChangeSet + afterGeneration → InteractionSessionManager → footprint intersection → Continue / ReResolve / Rebase / Cancel → user eventually requests commit → resolve candidate against current canonical state → OperationEngine current-state validation → Applied or Rejected ``` 第一层的目标是保持 UX 稳定并尽早丢弃 stale preview；第二层才是 correctness authority。 Proposed Freeze: 即使 Interaction 层漏掉一次 conflict notice，最终 OperationEngine validation 仍必须阻止非法 stale mutation；反过来，即使 Operation 最终可能仍合法，Interaction 层也不能在没有 session-specific semantic proof 时静默 rebase 用户 intent。 # 4. InteractionDependencyFootprint — Local Control Concept 为了避免“generation 一变就 cancel”，每个会写 Document 的 active session应维护一个逻辑 InteractionDependencyFootprint。这是 Control metadata，不是 ABI/wire freeze： ```txt InteractionDependencyFootprint ├ baseSemanticGeneration ├ primary target ObjectIds ├ per-target semantic components read │ ├ Placement / hierarchy │ ├ Transform │ ├ Properties / capability-affecting fields │ ├ Content │ └ EraseMasks / relation data as needed ├ related ObjectIds / parent / attachment dependencies └ optional dynamic query dependencies ``` 规则： - footprint 只包含“用户当前 intent 正确解释所依赖的 canonical facts”； - snap candidate / hover object 若仅是 transient hint，不自动成为 canonical dependency； - parent/ancestor world-basis、Connector attachment target 等若影响 final semantic result，应进入 footprint； - footprint 可以随安全 rebase/re-resolve 更新； - exact container/bitmask API OPEN。 ChangeSet 与 footprint 的 component-level intersection 是 proactive conflict classifier；SemanticGeneration 只用于判断“是否值得检查/是否丢了 change notices”。 # 5. Conflict Action Vocabulary 07-14 冻结四种 interaction-side action；它们不是 Operation disposition：
Action Meaning Canonical mutation?
Continue ChangeSet 与 session semantic dependency 不相交，继续当前 transient session No
ReResolve 保留原始 user intent/transient input，重新对 current canonical state 做 hit/target/semantic resolve No
Rebase session-specific deterministic rule 能把当前 transient intent 映射到新的 canonical base No
Cancel 目标/基准已失效或无法证明安全映射；丢弃未 committed transient state No
CommitRejected 是 OperationEngine 的最终结果，不是第五种主动 conflict strategy。若 session-specific rule 不存在或无法证明 intent-preserving，默认不得 silent rebase；应 Cancel/Resync 或让最终 commit 明确 Rejected。 # 6. Canonical Change → Active Session Sequence ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Sync as Remote / Other Source participant Sem as Axiom Ordered Runtime participant SM as SessionManager participant S as Active Session participant Op as OperationEngine Sync->>Sem: canonical Operation Sem->>Op: validate + atomic apply Op-->>Sem: Applied + ChangeSet + Gnext Sem-->>SM: SemanticChangeNotice(Gnext, ChangeSet) SM->>SM: intersect session footprint alt disjoint SM-->>S: Continue else re-resolvable SM-->>S: ReResolve(current canonical) else deterministic session rebase exists SM-->>S: Rebase(current canonical) else invalid/ambiguous SM-->>S: Cancel / Resync end S->>Op: final candidate when user commits Op-->>S: Applied or Rejected by current state ``` Remote apply 从不等待此 sequence 完成。Interaction notification 可以跨 executor handoff，但 final commit resolver必须读取 current canonical state/fence，不能只相信旧 preview。 # 7. Session-Specific Conflict Matrix
Session Concurrent semantic change Baseline action Status
StrokeSession unrelated existing objects change Continue；new stroke identity/candidate independent Proposed Freeze
StrokeSession placement parent / required attachment context deleted or invalidated Cancel or session-specific ReResolve；不得提交 dangling placement Proposed Freeze boundary / exact parent policy OPEN
EraserSession candidate stroke deleted prune + ReResolve current sweep against current state Proposed Freeze
EraserSession target geometry/transform changes ReResolve hit/result from retained sweep geometry；final Operation still current-state validate Proposed Freeze
TransformSession non-target object change Continue；Snap/guide可动态更新 Proposed Freeze
TransformSession target deleted / capability invalid Cancel Proposed Freeze
TransformSession target/ancestor Transform or Placement changes mark stale；only explicit session rebase rule may continue, otherwise Cancel Framework Proposed Freeze；rebase semantics OPEN
TextEditSession target deleted end/cancel session；uncommitted composition discarded Proposed Freeze
TextEditSession same RichText content changes EditorProjection stale → Resync；active uncommitted composition not auto-committed Proposed Freeze boundary；merge policy OPEN
TextEditSession object transform/viewport geometry changes only update overlay geometry / Continue Proposed Freeze
ConnectorEndpointSession edited connector deleted Cancel Proposed Freeze
ConnectorEndpointSession attachment/endpoint relation changed concurrently stale → explicit ReResolve/Rebase rule or Cancel Framework Proposed Freeze；exact conflict OPEN
Selection/Viewport local session canonical changes selection prunes invalid IDs；viewport generally Continue Proposed Freeze
# 8. TransformSession — Same-Target Remote Change Transform 是最容易误做 silent last-write-wins 的场景。 ```txt Begin @ G10 base transform T0 user preview delta D remote @ G11 changes same target → T1 ``` 07-14 不擅自冻结最终产品语义为： ```txt absolute local transform wins or T1 ∘ D relative rebase or server ordering wins without UX notice ``` 这些属于 collaboration semantics。 本文只冻结： 1. G11 ChangeSet(Transform/Placement) 必须命中 TransformSession footprint； 2. session 进入 stale/conflict handling； 3. 若未来注册 TransformRebasePolicy，必须基于 current canonical T1 确定性重算 transient preview，并更新 base generation； 4. 没有明确 policy 时 V1 安全 fallback = Cancel，而不是继续拿 T0 生成 absolute stale result； 5. 无论是否 rebase，最终 SetTransforms 仍由 OperationEngine current-state validation。 INTERACT-REMOTE-TRANSFORM-01 — OPEN: relative delta composition、multi-selection 中部分 target concurrent change、parent-world-transform change 的 exact user semantics。 # 9. TextEditSession — Remote RichText / IME Text / IME authority 已有 Resyncing 状态，07-14 将其接到 concurrent ChangeSet： ```txt Remote EditRichText same object → canonical apply first → ChangeSet(Content) / new generation → EditorProjection stale → TextEditSession Resyncing ``` ## 9.1 No active composition 如果没有 uncommitted composition： - rebuild/reconcile EditorProjection from canonical RichText； - caret/selection 可在 stable ParagraphId + scalar position 能安全映射时重投影； - 旧 projection generation 的平台 callbacks 必须丢弃； - 后续 committed action 再从新 projection resolve RichTextDelta。 ## 9.2 Active composition Proposed Freeze safety baseline: remote same-object RichText change 到来时，未 committed composition 不能被 Axiom自动转换成 EditRichText 来“抢救”。若没有专门 merge/rebase authority，先 cancel/drop uncommitted composition，再从最新 canonical RichText resync projection。 已成功 applied 的 earlier text edits不回滚。 INTERACT-REMOTE-TEXT-01 — OPEN: 未来如果引入 RichText CRDT/OT，active composition range 如何跨 remote delta 映射/保留、selection affinity 与 composing text merge semantics 需由 RichText Collaboration authority 单独冻结。 # 10. Multi-Operation Intent — First Class Local Orchestration Problem 一个 batch 不一定是一个 user intent；一个 user intent 也不一定只有一个 Operation。07-14 区分： ```txt Independent Operation Batch = transport/executor amortization = per-item mixed result legal Coherent MultiOperation Intent = product expects one user-level command/result = local orchestration needs preflight + failure containment ``` Group / Ungroup、multi-op Undo/Redo、某些 erase/import command 属于第二类；Remote applyOperations(batch) 默认仍属于第一类。 INTENT-INV-01 — Prefer One Existing Atomic Operation When Semantically Possible. multi-selection transform 使用一个 SetTransforms batch；subtree delete 使用一个 DeleteObjects；RichText replace 使用一个 EditRichText delta。只有跨 OperationKind / schema boundary 时才进入 MultiOperation Intent。 # 11. Local IntentPlan — Control, Not Canonical 概念： ```txt LocalIntentPlan ├ intentId / UndoIntentKey // local only ├ baseSemanticGeneration ├ ordered Operation candidates [O0..On] ├ staged semantic dependencies ├ before-image / inverse inputs needed for compensation ├ completion policy └ diagnostics ``` LocalIntentPlan： - 不进入 Operation envelope； - 不进入 Cloud protocol； - 不成为 Snapshot semantic state； - 不自动获得 crash atomicity； - exact C++ layout OPEN。 推荐 completion policy 逻辑分两类： - Coherent：Group/Ungroup/Undo 等 product command 不希望保留 failed prefix； - BestEffort：只有产品明确允许 partial success 时使用。 V1 structural commands默认应使用 Coherent；不能把“实现简单”当成 BestEffort 的理由。 # 12. Sequence Preflight — Must Use Staged State multi-op preflight 不能把每条 Operation都对同一个初始 Document 独立 validate，因为后项可能依赖前项： ```txt Group: S0 → preflight InsertObjects(Group G) → staged S1 → preflight SetPlacements(children → G) against S1 → staged S2 ``` Proposed Freeze INTENT-01 — Coherent MultiOperation Intent 在 first canonical apply 前必须对完整 ordered sequence 做 staged semantic preflight，复用 OperationEngine 的 decode/validation/prepare semantics；不得在 Editor 层复制一套弱 validator。 Preflight： - 不推进 SemanticGeneration； - 不分配 CanonicalCommitStamp； - 不写 OperationId applied index； - 不产生 ChangeSet / History / DataBridge event； - 失败则 zero canonical mutation。 如果 expensive candidate resolve 在 ordered lane 外完成，则 preflight 必须绑定 baseSemanticGeneration；真正 admission 前 generation 已变化时，必须重新 preflight或使用可证明等价的 dependency fence，不能沿用 stale staged plan。 # 13. IntentCommitSegment — Scheduling Barrier, Not Transaction Preflight成功后，Coherent intent进入一个短、bounded、same-document ordered-lane commit segment： ```txt enter IntentCommitSegment → verify preflight base / rerun preflight if needed → apply O0 → apply O1 → ... → apply On → close segment ``` Proposed Freeze INTENT-02 — IntentCommitSegment 只防止其他 canonical Operations 在这组本地 commits 中间 interleave；它不提供 semantic rollback、Cloud atomicity、durability atomicity 或 single-generation publication。 因此每个 APPLIED item仍然： ```txt own SemanticGeneration successor own CanonicalCommitStamp own ChangeSet own local DataBridge publication own persistence/sync eligibility ``` segment 绝不能： - 跨 pointer gesture / 等用户继续输入； - 等 DB / network / render / present； - 因为一个长 AI/import intent长期阻塞 remote apply； - 伪装成一个 Operation。 exact max op count / CPU time budget = OPEN / Benchmark。 # 14. Apply Result Semantics Inside a Coherent Intent 沿用 07-11： - APPLIED = 新 canonical mutation； - ALREADY_APPLIED = 同 OperationId/payload 的安全 retry completion，不产生第二次 mutation； - REJECTED = 当前 item无 mutation； - request-level fatal failure 不能推导“零 mutation”。 对 coherent retry：完全相同 intent plan 必须重用相同 OperationIds，这样已成功 prefix 收敛为 ALREADY_APPLIED。 INTENT-03 — Rejected stops the remaining coherent forward sequence. Oi REJECTED 后不继续盲目 apply Oi+1...On，因为后项可能依赖已失败 item 的 staged post-state。 # 15. Middle Failure → Compensation, Never Hidden Rollback 若完整 preflight 已成功、segment 内无 interleaving，但仍出现： ```txt O0 APPLIED O1 APPLIED O2 REJECTED / fatal uncertain ``` 处理分两步。 ## 15.1 First establish actual per-item outcome 如果是 request-level/unknown failure，先用相同 OperationIds + bytes re-drive/查询到稳定 disposition；不能在不知道 O1 是否已经 Applied 时直接生成 compensation。 ## 15.2 Coherent intent compensation 对于 Coherent policy： ```txt Applied prefix → derive inverse from captured before-image / prepared compensation inputs → submit new canonical compensating Operation(s) → normal validation + atomic apply → normal ChangeSet / local publication / persistence / sync ``` Proposed Freeze INTENT-04 — Compensation 是新的 canonical Operation，不是 memory rollback。 已发布的 Operation、Generation、CommitStamp、OpLog/Outbox evidence不被删除或改写。 Group例： ```txt InsertObjects(G) Applied SetPlacements(children→G) Rejected → compensate DeleteObjects(G) ``` Ungroup例： ```txt SetPlacements(children→oldParent) Applied DeleteObjects(G) Rejected → compensate SetPlacements(children→G original placements) ``` 因为单个 SetPlacements 本身 whole-op atomic，compensation只处理跨 Operation prefix，不处理 Operation内部 partial write。 若 compensation 本身无法完成，runtime/editor必须进入 explicit failed/degraded intent handling；不得把 UI 报成“已回滚”。 # 16. UndoIntent / History Finalization 07-14 收敛 OPFLOW-02： ```txt user command/session resolves coherent intent → create provisional local UndoIntent context → preflight + commit segment → if all required Operations positively complete finalize one user-visible HistoryGroup → if zero Applied and failed discard provisional intent → if prefix Applied then fully compensated do not expose a successful user Undo item; retain diagnostics/internal compensation provenance as implementation needs ``` UndoIntentId / HistoryGroupId 继续不进入 canonical wire。 Undo/Redo 自己若生成多条 compensating Operations，也走同一 Coherent IntentPlan + preflight框架；不能因为“这是 Undo”而绕过 current-state validation。 # 17. Important Limitation — No Crash / Cross-Client Intent Atomicity Current Direction / Explicit Non-guarantee: 07-14 的 IntentCommitSegment + compensation 解决当前进程内的 interleaving 与 middle-failure containment，不宣称 multi-Operation user intent 跨 crash 或跨客户端原子。 因为 Operations 是独立 durable/sync units，理论上可能： ```txt O0 committed + locally durable → process crash before O1 ``` restart 后恢复出合法 canonical prefix。Group 的空 Group、Ungroup 的“children 已移出但 Group 尚存在”都必须保持 schema-valid，不能因为 user intent未完成就破坏 recovery correctness。 同样远端 peer 可能先看到 forward prefix，再看到后续/compensation。 INTENT-CRASH-01 — OPEN: 如果产品未来要求 user-intent-level crash atomicity / cross-client atomic visibility，需要 durable local IntentRecoveryRecord、server grouping/commit barrier 或新的 canonical semantic primitive专项设计；不得偷偷把 UndoIntent升级成 Transaction。 # 18. Lifecycle Interruption Baseline 07-14 将 Lifecycle active-session OPEN 收敛为两个不同事件族。 ## 18.1 Interaction interruption Background / explicit Suspend / Canvas detach / destroy / platform pointer cancel 默认进入 interruption barrier： ```txt stop admitting new interaction input → drain already-ordered terminal/commit signals → inspect each active session ├ Operation already accepted into atomic apply → let disposition finish └ otherwise → Cancel / end uncommitted transient state → release pointer capture / transient preview/editor projection → quiesce runtime ``` 不得自动把 preview final frame当 commit。 Text：只有平台已经明确产生 committed edit action并在 barrier 前进入 semantic submit path，才可完成；纯 composing text默认 cancel/drop，不合成 Operation。 ## 18.2 Presentation interruption only Surface Lost / GPU Device Lost 本身只改变 presentation/derived state： - 不自动 cancel semantic session； - 如果 pointer/input capture仍有效，session可以继续，preview可 degrade/fallback； - 如果平台同时报告 pointer capture lost / host detach / input cancel，再按 Interaction interruption cancel； - old surface generation feedback不能反向完成新的 semantic commit。 这保持： ```txt Surface/Device loss != Document loss != Interaction cancel ``` 但平台是否能在具体 surface-loss场景继续提供可靠 pointer/IME input属于 Platform profile。 # 19. Session Interruption Matrix
Session Background / Suspend Surface/Device Loss only
Stroke uncommitted stroke Cancel；已进入 apply 的 AddStroke让其完成 input连续则可继续；input cancel则 Cancel
Eraser discard sweep / candidate / preview；no guessed erase commit 可继续 semantic sweep；preview可重建
Transform Cancel preview transform；canonical stays current input连续则 session可保留；render preview重建
TextEdit end/resync editor projection；uncommitted composition cancel；已 committed edits保留 若 editor host仍有效可继续；host detach则 end/cancel transient
Connector Cancel endpoint/create preview input连续则可继续/rebuild preview
Viewport end gesture；no Document mutation rebind后继续新 viewport interaction
Resume后不恢复旧 uncommitted InteractionSession；从当前 canonical Document / current editor state创建新 session。Process crash更是如此：只有已经进入 canonical + durability path 的事实参与 07-08 recovery。 # 20. Thread / Ordering Contract ```txt Remote/DataBridge or Local Command → Document Ordered Runtime Lane → canonical commit → ChangeSet publication ├→ Scene └→ Interaction conflict notice Input Hot Path / Interaction Executor → transient session updates → final resolve → OperationSubmitPort → Ordered Runtime Lane ``` 规则： - Remote apply 不同步等待 Interaction executor处理 conflict； - Interaction conflict notice按 generation有序消费；若 notice gap/lag不可证明，session在 commit前必须以 current canonical read重新 resolve/preflight； - IntentCommitSegment 只在 Ordered Runtime lane短暂序列化 canonical commits； - preflight/compensation不得等待 Persistence / Sync / Render / Present； - lifecycle barrier停止新 ingress，但不得中断一个已经进入 OperationEngine atomic mutation的 Operation。 # 21. Failure Matrix
Scenario Required behavior
remote unrelated change during Transform Continue；generation变化本身不 cancel
remote deletes transform target Cancel session；no stale SetTransforms
remote changes same transform stale；explicit rebase policy or Cancel；final validation mandatory
remote RichText same object while composing apply remote first；cancel uncommitted composition + resync baseline unless future merge authority
Group preflight O1 invalid zero canonical mutation
Group O0 applied then O1 unexpectedly rejected stop forward sequence；compensate O0 with new canonical op
request-level failure after unknown prefix re-drive same OperationIds to determine Applied/AlreadyApplied/Rejected before compensation
crash between coherent intent Operations recover canonical durable prefix；do not invent hidden rollback；intent-level crash atomicity OPEN
background during active preview no auto commit；cancel unless canonical apply already accepted
surface lost during pointer stream semantic session may continue if input continuity valid；presentation rebuild independently
# 22. Observability 建议最少事件/字段： ```txt interaction.session.begin interaction.session.conflict_notice interaction.session.conflict_action // continue|reresolve|rebase|cancel interaction.session.stale_generation interaction.session.commit_rejected interaction.session.interrupted intent.plan.created intent.preflight.begin/end intent.preflight.rejected intent.segment.begin/end intent.item.disposition intent.compensation.begin/end intent.compensation.failed text.projection.resync lifecycle.interaction_barrier.begin/end ``` Correlation： - InteractionSessionId / IntentId仅 local diagnostics； - canonical correlation使用 OperationId / CanonicalCommitStamp； - 不把 local session/intent IDs塞入 Operation payload。 # 23. Verification / Correctness Oracle 必须覆盖： 1. remote unrelated change during Transform → session持续；final SetTransforms合法。 2. remote delete transform target → session Cancel，Document只有 remote delete。 3. remote same-target transform → 无注册 rebase policy时不得 silent stale commit。 4. remote same RichText edit during no-composition → EditorProjection resync，旧 generation callback被拒。 5. remote same RichText edit during composition → composition不会自动进入 Operation；安全 baseline cancel + resync。 6. Eraser candidate deleted remotely → re-resolve sweep，不生成 stale target delete。 7. Group staged preflight第二步失败 → first Operation未 apply。 8. Group preflight成功，但 injected O1 rejection after O0 → compensation使最终 canonical projection等价 pre-intent（Operation history不同允许）。 9. Ungroup middle failure → placements compensation恢复。 10. Retry unknown multi-op request → same OperationIds使 applied prefix返回 AlreadyApplied，无重复 mutation。 11. coherent segment期间 remote Operation不能 interleave；segment结束后 remote继续正常 apply。 12. crash after durable O0 before O1 → 07-08恢复合法 prefix，不假装 intent原子。 13. background Active Transform/Stroke/Eraser → no guessed canonical commit。 14. background during Text composition → no composing string进入 OpLog/Sync。 15. surface/device loss with surviving input → canonical generation不因 loss变化；session可继续/重建 preview。 16. surface loss + pointer cancel → session cancel，no canonical side effect。 17. final OperationEngine validation必须能拒绝任何 Interaction层漏检的 stale/invalid candidate。 # 24. Resolution Registry
Prior GAP / Question 07-14 Resolution Status
GAP-05 / remote vs active InteractionSession framework已冻结：remote apply不被session阻塞；ChangeSet→footprint→Continue/ReResolve/Rebase/Cancel；final current-state validation。具体 Transform/Text/Connector merge semantics拆为专项 OPEN Resolved — Proposed Freeze framework
SPECIAL-MULTIOP-01 / OPFLOW-01 Coherent IntentPlan → staged preflight → short non-interleaving commit segment → stop-on-reject → canonical compensation；no global Transaction Resolved — Proposed Freeze framework
OPFLOW-02 UndoIntent creation/finalization provisional local context before execution；only successful coherent completion finalizes user-visible HistoryGroup；failed+fully-compensated intent不成为成功 Undo item Resolved — Proposed Freeze
Lifecycle active InteractionSession interruption Background/Suspend/detach/destroy/input-cancel取消未 committed session；surface/device loss alone不等于 cancel Resolved — Proposed Freeze baseline
# 25. Remaining OPEN - INTERACT-REMOTE-TRANSFORM-01 — same-target Transform/Placement 的 exact rebase/merge user semantics。 - INTERACT-REMOTE-TEXT-01 — RichText CRDT/OT 与 active composition range/selection mapping。 - INTERACT-REMOTE-CONNECTOR-01 — connector/attachment concurrent mutation与 connector referential delete policy 对接。 - INTERACT-FOOTPRINT-01 — InteractionDependencyFootprint exact C++ representation / dynamic ancestor dependency tracking。 - INTENT-API-01 — LocalIntentPlan / staged preflight / prepared apply plan exact C++ API、allocator、shadow-state实现。 - INTENT-BUDGET-01 — commit segment max operation count / time budget；大型 import/AI 如何拆分。 - INTENT-CRASH-01 — user-intent-level crash atomicity / durable IntentRecoveryRecord 是否需要。 - INTENT-CLOUD-01 — 是否有产品场景要求跨客户端整 intent 原子可见；若需要必须另设 protocol/semantic authority。 - HISTORY-01 — UndoIntent/HistoryGroup 是否持久化及 retention window。 - LIFE-INTERACT-01 — 各平台 background/IME/pointer-cancel callback 的 exact ordering 与 surface-loss input-continuity profile。 # 26. Handoff 07-14 完成后，Interaction 与 multi-op intent 的 integration framework 已足以支持稳定内部 API 与 conformance tests。下一优先窄专项进入： 07-15 Presented Proof / CanonicalVisible / Arc Handoff ABI Integration Contract 重点关闭： ```txt PresentSubmitted → platform PresentedFeedback → surface generation / frame identity → canonical coverage proof → CanonicalVisible(token) → Arc preview clear ``` 并把 GAP-01B / RENDER-01 / Frame-Present identity 与 Windows / Android / Apple / Web 的具体 proof capability真正接上。 ","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/3c44c57a590c81028a5ff4a974c9240d?pvs=204","metadata":{"type":"page"},"cover":null,"icon":{"type":"emoji","emoji":"⚖️"},"path":"Axiom 整体架构基线 v0.4 / 07 Runtime Data Flow","verification":{"state":"unverified"},"page_last_edited_at":"2026-08-22T17:16:55.506Z"}

structuredContent.text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3c44c57a590c81028a5ff4a974c9240d as of 2026-08-22T17:16:55.830Z: {"title":"07-14 Interaction Conflict / Multi-Operation Intent Integration Contract v0.1"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"⚖️"} Status: Proposed Freeze — Interaction Conflict Boundary / Multi-Operation Intent Orchestration Contract. 本页承接 07-09 暴露的 remote Operation vs active InteractionSession、SPECIAL-MULTIOP-01 与 Lifecycle active-session interruption GAP。本文不引入新的 canonical Transaction、不改变 15 类 Operation vocabulary，也不定义 CRDT/OT；它冻结的是：canonical change 到来后谁判断 session stale、谁可以 re-resolve/rebase/cancel、final current-state validation 在哪里发生，以及一个 coherent user intent 跨多个 Operations 时如何 preflight、短临界区执行、失败 containment 与 compensation。 # 0. Authority / Scope 直接 authority： - — InteractionSession transient boundary、StartContext、一个 intent 可产生多个 Operations、Cancel vs Undo。 - — InteractionSessionManager、semanticGenerationAtBegin、Semantic ChangeSet notification、OperationSubmitPort、remote-active-session policy此前 OPEN。 - — TextEditSession / EditorProjection、composition transient、stale projection → Resyncing。 - — whole-operation validation、单 Operation atomicity、no partial apply、15 类 Operation。 - — one intent → 1..N Operations、UndoIntent local-only、multi-op failure OPFLOW GAP。 - — Special Flow stress test；remote-vs-active 与 multi-op intent failure此前保持 OPEN。 - — SemanticGeneration / ChangeSet / ApplyBatchResult；batch mixed outcomes legal；batch 不是 Transaction。 - — App / Canvas / Document / Surface / Sync lifecycle 分离；active session interruption此前 OPEN。 - — remote persist-first → ordered canonical apply → ChangeSet / no echo。 本文冻结 integration ownership、conflict framework、preflight/admission/failure containment、lifecycle baseline。本文不冻结： - Transform 同目标并发时采用 absolute-wins、relative-delta rebase、server-order 或其他产品 semantics； - RichText 同对象并发编辑的 CRDT/OT/merge algorithm； - Connector referential conflict 的最终 collaboration policy； - public C ABI exact struct / symbol names； - UndoIntent durable storage； - 跨客户端“整个 user intent 原子可见”的协议语义。 # 1. Core Invariants IC-INV-01 — Active Session Has No Canonical Veto. active InteractionSession / TransformSession / TextEditSession 不能阻塞、拒绝或重排已经 order-qualified 的 Remote/other-canvas canonical Operation。Remote apply 先按正常 ordered lane 完成；session 在 post-commit ChangeSet 后处理 stale/conflict。 IC-INV-02 — Conflict Resolution Is Transient. Continue / ReResolve / Rebase / Cancel 都只修改 Interaction/Editor transient state；它们本身不写 SemanticDocument、不生成隐藏 Operation。只有用户最终 commit/显式 compensation 才进入 canonical path。 IC-INV-03 — Generation Is a Trigger, Not Conflict Meaning. semanticGenerationAtBegin != currentGeneration 只说明“期间发生过 canonical change”，不等于一定冲突。真正冲突由 session 的 semantic dependency footprint 与 post-commit ChangeSet 相交判断。 IC-INV-04 — OperationEngine Is Final Authority. Interaction preflight/rebase 决不能替代 OperationEngine 的 current-state whole-op validation。任何 stale candidate 最终仍可被 Rejected；OperationEngine 不自动猜测/重写用户 intent。 IC-INV-05 — No Global Transaction. IntentPlan / IntentCommitSegment / UndoIntent / ApplyBatchResult 都不是 canonical Transaction。每个 Operation 仍独立形成自己的 SemanticGeneration / CanonicalCommitStamp / ChangeSet / local publication。 IC-INV-06 — No Auto-Commit on Interruption. Background / Suspend / detach / destroy 不允许把最后一帧 preview、未提交 transform、未完成 eraser sweep 或 IME composing text“猜成”canonical commit。若 Operation 已被 Ordered Runtime 接受进入 atomic apply，则允许该 Operation 正常完成；否则 uncommitted transient state 走 cancel/end。 # 2. Ownership — Who Decides What
Responsibility Owner Must not do
Remote ordering / durable inbound / dispatch Shared Data Runtime 等待 active gesture 决定 remote 能否 apply
Canonical validate / idempotency / atomic apply Axiom OperationEngine 根据 pointer/preview/IME 自动 rebase intent
Post-commit conflict notification Semantic Core → Interaction Runtime 让 session veto 已完成 commit
Session dependency footprint / stale classification InteractionSessionManager + session type 修改 SemanticDocument
ReResolve / Rebase / Cancel Concrete InteractionSession 产生不可见 semantic mutation
Multi-op user-intent grouping / failure policy Editor Intent Coordinator / History boundary 把 UndoIntent 写进 Operation wire
Sequence semantic preflight OperationEngine semantic validation reused by Intent Coordinator 复制第二套 validator
Compensating canonical mutations OperationEngine, source=local compensation/control 内存指针回滚已 committed state
Lifecycle interruption barrier InteractionRuntime + Platform Lifecycle control 因为 surface lost 直接 reload Document
# 3. Two-Layer Conflict Defense 冲突防护分成主动 session 层与最终 semantic 层： ```txt Canonical Commit from any source → ChangeSet + afterGeneration → InteractionSessionManager → footprint intersection → Continue / ReResolve / Rebase / Cancel → user eventually requests commit → resolve candidate against current canonical state → OperationEngine current-state validation → Applied or Rejected ``` 第一层的目标是保持 UX 稳定并尽早丢弃 stale preview；第二层才是 correctness authority。 Proposed Freeze: 即使 Interaction 层漏掉一次 conflict notice，最终 OperationEngine validation 仍必须阻止非法 stale mutation；反过来，即使 Operation 最终可能仍合法，Interaction 层也不能在没有 session-specific semantic proof 时静默 rebase 用户 intent。 # 4. InteractionDependencyFootprint — Local Control Concept 为了避免“generation 一变就 cancel”，每个会写 Document 的 active session应维护一个逻辑 InteractionDependencyFootprint。这是 Control metadata，不是 ABI/wire freeze： ```txt InteractionDependencyFootprint ├ baseSemanticGeneration ├ primary target ObjectIds ├ per-target semantic components read │ ├ Placement / hierarchy │ ├ Transform │ ├ Properties / capability-affecting fields │ ├ Content │ └ EraseMasks / relation data as needed ├ related ObjectIds / parent / attachment dependencies └ optional dynamic query dependencies ``` 规则： - footprint 只包含“用户当前 intent 正确解释所依赖的 canonical facts”； - snap candidate / hover object 若仅是 transient hint，不自动成为 canonical dependency； - parent/ancestor world-basis、Connector attachment target 等若影响 final semantic result，应进入 footprint； - footprint 可以随安全 rebase/re-resolve 更新； - exact container/bitmask API OPEN。 ChangeSet 与 footprint 的 component-level intersection 是 proactive conflict classifier；SemanticGeneration 只用于判断“是否值得检查/是否丢了 change notices”。 # 5. Conflict Action Vocabulary 07-14 冻结四种 interaction-side action；它们不是 Operation disposition：
Action Meaning Canonical mutation?
Continue ChangeSet 与 session semantic dependency 不相交，继续当前 transient session No
ReResolve 保留原始 user intent/transient input，重新对 current canonical state 做 hit/target/semantic resolve No
Rebase session-specific deterministic rule 能把当前 transient intent 映射到新的 canonical base No
Cancel 目标/基准已失效或无法证明安全映射；丢弃未 committed transient state No
CommitRejected 是 OperationEngine 的最终结果，不是第五种主动 conflict strategy。若 session-specific rule 不存在或无法证明 intent-preserving，默认不得 silent rebase；应 Cancel/Resync 或让最终 commit 明确 Rejected。 # 6. Canonical Change → Active Session Sequence ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Sync as Remote / Other Source participant Sem as Axiom Ordered Runtime participant SM as SessionManager participant S as Active Session participant Op as OperationEngine Sync->>Sem: canonical Operation Sem->>Op: validate + atomic apply Op-->>Sem: Applied + ChangeSet + Gnext Sem-->>SM: SemanticChangeNotice(Gnext, ChangeSet) SM->>SM: intersect session footprint alt disjoint SM-->>S: Continue else re-resolvable SM-->>S: ReResolve(current canonical) else deterministic session rebase exists SM-->>S: Rebase(current canonical) else invalid/ambiguous SM-->>S: Cancel / Resync end S->>Op: final candidate when user commits Op-->>S: Applied or Rejected by current state ``` Remote apply 从不等待此 sequence 完成。Interaction notification 可以跨 executor handoff，但 final commit resolver必须读取 current canonical state/fence，不能只相信旧 preview。 # 7. Session-Specific Conflict Matrix
Session Concurrent semantic change Baseline action Status
StrokeSession unrelated existing objects change Continue；new stroke identity/candidate independent Proposed Freeze
StrokeSession placement parent / required attachment context deleted or invalidated Cancel or session-specific ReResolve；不得提交 dangling placement Proposed Freeze boundary / exact parent policy OPEN
EraserSession candidate stroke deleted prune + ReResolve current sweep against current state Proposed Freeze
EraserSession target geometry/transform changes ReResolve hit/result from retained sweep geometry；final Operation still current-state validate Proposed Freeze
TransformSession non-target object change Continue；Snap/guide可动态更新 Proposed Freeze
TransformSession target deleted / capability invalid Cancel Proposed Freeze
TransformSession target/ancestor Transform or Placement changes mark stale；only explicit session rebase rule may continue, otherwise Cancel Framework Proposed Freeze；rebase semantics OPEN
TextEditSession target deleted end/cancel session；uncommitted composition discarded Proposed Freeze
TextEditSession same RichText content changes EditorProjection stale → Resync；active uncommitted composition not auto-committed Proposed Freeze boundary；merge policy OPEN
TextEditSession object transform/viewport geometry changes only update overlay geometry / Continue Proposed Freeze
ConnectorEndpointSession edited connector deleted Cancel Proposed Freeze
ConnectorEndpointSession attachment/endpoint relation changed concurrently stale → explicit ReResolve/Rebase rule or Cancel Framework Proposed Freeze；exact conflict OPEN
Selection/Viewport local session canonical changes selection prunes invalid IDs；viewport generally Continue Proposed Freeze
# 8. TransformSession — Same-Target Remote Change Transform 是最容易误做 silent last-write-wins 的场景。 ```txt Begin @ G10 base transform T0 user preview delta D remote @ G11 changes same target → T1 ``` 07-14 不擅自冻结最终产品语义为： ```txt absolute local transform wins or T1 ∘ D relative rebase or server ordering wins without UX notice ``` 这些属于 collaboration semantics。 本文只冻结： 1. G11 ChangeSet(Transform/Placement) 必须命中 TransformSession footprint； 2. session 进入 stale/conflict handling； 3. 若未来注册 TransformRebasePolicy，必须基于 current canonical T1 确定性重算 transient preview，并更新 base generation； 4. 没有明确 policy 时 V1 安全 fallback = Cancel，而不是继续拿 T0 生成 absolute stale result； 5. 无论是否 rebase，最终 SetTransforms 仍由 OperationEngine current-state validation。 INTERACT-REMOTE-TRANSFORM-01 — OPEN: relative delta composition、multi-selection 中部分 target concurrent change、parent-world-transform change 的 exact user semantics。 # 9. TextEditSession — Remote RichText / IME Text / IME authority 已有 Resyncing 状态，07-14 将其接到 concurrent ChangeSet： ```txt Remote EditRichText same object → canonical apply first → ChangeSet(Content) / new generation → EditorProjection stale → TextEditSession Resyncing ``` ## 9.1 No active composition 如果没有 uncommitted composition： - rebuild/reconcile EditorProjection from canonical RichText； - caret/selection 可在 stable ParagraphId + scalar position 能安全映射时重投影； - 旧 projection generation 的平台 callbacks 必须丢弃； - 后续 committed action 再从新 projection resolve RichTextDelta。 ## 9.2 Active composition Proposed Freeze safety baseline: remote same-object RichText change 到来时，未 committed composition 不能被 Axiom自动转换成 EditRichText 来“抢救”。若没有专门 merge/rebase authority，先 cancel/drop uncommitted composition，再从最新 canonical RichText resync projection。 已成功 applied 的 earlier text edits不回滚。 INTERACT-REMOTE-TEXT-01 — OPEN: 未来如果引入 RichText CRDT/OT，active composition range 如何跨 remote delta 映射/保留、selection affinity 与 composing text merge semantics 需由 RichText Collaboration authority 单独冻结。 # 10. Multi-Operation Intent — First Class Local Orchestration Problem 一个 batch 不一定是一个 user intent；一个 user intent 也不一定只有一个 Operation。07-14 区分： ```txt Independent Operation Batch = transport/executor amortization = per-item mixed result legal Coherent MultiOperation Intent = product expects one user-level command/result = local orchestration needs preflight + failure containment ``` Group / Ungroup、multi-op Undo/Redo、某些 erase/import command 属于第二类；Remote applyOperations(batch) 默认仍属于第一类。 INTENT-INV-01 — Prefer One Existing Atomic Operation When Semantically Possible. multi-selection transform 使用一个 SetTransforms batch；subtree delete 使用一个 DeleteObjects；RichText replace 使用一个 EditRichText delta。只有跨 OperationKind / schema boundary 时才进入 MultiOperation Intent。 # 11. Local IntentPlan — Control, Not Canonical 概念： ```txt LocalIntentPlan ├ intentId / UndoIntentKey // local only ├ baseSemanticGeneration ├ ordered Operation candidates [O0..On] ├ staged semantic dependencies ├ before-image / inverse inputs needed for compensation ├ completion policy └ diagnostics ``` LocalIntentPlan： - 不进入 Operation envelope； - 不进入 Cloud protocol； - 不成为 Snapshot semantic state； - 不自动获得 crash atomicity； - exact C++ layout OPEN。 推荐 completion policy 逻辑分两类： - Coherent：Group/Ungroup/Undo 等 product command 不希望保留 failed prefix； - BestEffort：只有产品明确允许 partial success 时使用。 V1 structural commands默认应使用 Coherent；不能把“实现简单”当成 BestEffort 的理由。 # 12. Sequence Preflight — Must Use Staged State multi-op preflight 不能把每条 Operation都对同一个初始 Document 独立 validate，因为后项可能依赖前项： ```txt Group: S0 → preflight InsertObjects(Group G) → staged S1 → preflight SetPlacements(children → G) against S1 → staged S2 ``` Proposed Freeze INTENT-01 — Coherent MultiOperation Intent 在 first canonical apply 前必须对完整 ordered sequence 做 staged semantic preflight，复用 OperationEngine 的 decode/validation/prepare semantics；不得在 Editor 层复制一套弱 validator。 Preflight： - 不推进 SemanticGeneration； - 不分配 CanonicalCommitStamp； - 不写 OperationId applied index； - 不产生 ChangeSet / History / DataBridge event； - 失败则 zero canonical mutation。 如果 expensive candidate resolve 在 ordered lane 外完成，则 preflight 必须绑定 baseSemanticGeneration；真正 admission 前 generation 已变化时，必须重新 preflight或使用可证明等价的 dependency fence，不能沿用 stale staged plan。 # 13. IntentCommitSegment — Scheduling Barrier, Not Transaction Preflight成功后，Coherent intent进入一个短、bounded、same-document ordered-lane commit segment： ```txt enter IntentCommitSegment → verify preflight base / rerun preflight if needed → apply O0 → apply O1 → ... → apply On → close segment ``` Proposed Freeze INTENT-02 — IntentCommitSegment 只防止其他 canonical Operations 在这组本地 commits 中间 interleave；它不提供 semantic rollback、Cloud atomicity、durability atomicity 或 single-generation publication。 因此每个 APPLIED item仍然： ```txt own SemanticGeneration successor own CanonicalCommitStamp own ChangeSet own local DataBridge publication own persistence/sync eligibility ``` segment 绝不能： - 跨 pointer gesture / 等用户继续输入； - 等 DB / network / render / present； - 因为一个长 AI/import intent长期阻塞 remote apply； - 伪装成一个 Operation。 exact max op count / CPU time budget = OPEN / Benchmark。 # 14. Apply Result Semantics Inside a Coherent Intent 沿用 07-11： - APPLIED = 新 canonical mutation； - ALREADY_APPLIED = 同 OperationId/payload 的安全 retry completion，不产生第二次 mutation； - REJECTED = 当前 item无 mutation； - request-level fatal failure 不能推导“零 mutation”。 对 coherent retry：完全相同 intent plan 必须重用相同 OperationIds，这样已成功 prefix 收敛为 ALREADY_APPLIED。 INTENT-03 — Rejected stops the remaining coherent forward sequence. Oi REJECTED 后不继续盲目 apply Oi+1...On，因为后项可能依赖已失败 item 的 staged post-state。 # 15. Middle Failure → Compensation, Never Hidden Rollback 若完整 preflight 已成功、segment 内无 interleaving，但仍出现： ```txt O0 APPLIED O1 APPLIED O2 REJECTED / fatal uncertain ``` 处理分两步。 ## 15.1 First establish actual per-item outcome 如果是 request-level/unknown failure，先用相同 OperationIds + bytes re-drive/查询到稳定 disposition；不能在不知道 O1 是否已经 Applied 时直接生成 compensation。 ## 15.2 Coherent intent compensation 对于 Coherent policy： ```txt Applied prefix → derive inverse from captured before-image / prepared compensation inputs → submit new canonical compensating Operation(s) → normal validation + atomic apply → normal ChangeSet / local publication / persistence / sync ``` Proposed Freeze INTENT-04 — Compensation 是新的 canonical Operation，不是 memory rollback。 已发布的 Operation、Generation、CommitStamp、OpLog/Outbox evidence不被删除或改写。 Group例： ```txt InsertObjects(G) Applied SetPlacements(children→G) Rejected → compensate DeleteObjects(G) ``` Ungroup例： ```txt SetPlacements(children→oldParent) Applied DeleteObjects(G) Rejected → compensate SetPlacements(children→G original placements) ``` 因为单个 SetPlacements 本身 whole-op atomic，compensation只处理跨 Operation prefix，不处理 Operation内部 partial write。 若 compensation 本身无法完成，runtime/editor必须进入 explicit failed/degraded intent handling；不得把 UI 报成“已回滚”。 # 16. UndoIntent / History Finalization 07-14 收敛 OPFLOW-02： ```txt user command/session resolves coherent intent → create provisional local UndoIntent context → preflight + commit segment → if all required Operations positively complete finalize one user-visible HistoryGroup → if zero Applied and failed discard provisional intent → if prefix Applied then fully compensated do not expose a successful user Undo item; retain diagnostics/internal compensation provenance as implementation needs ``` UndoIntentId / HistoryGroupId 继续不进入 canonical wire。 Undo/Redo 自己若生成多条 compensating Operations，也走同一 Coherent IntentPlan + preflight框架；不能因为“这是 Undo”而绕过 current-state validation。 # 17. Important Limitation — No Crash / Cross-Client Intent Atomicity Current Direction / Explicit Non-guarantee: 07-14 的 IntentCommitSegment + compensation 解决当前进程内的 interleaving 与 middle-failure containment，不宣称 multi-Operation user intent 跨 crash 或跨客户端原子。 因为 Operations 是独立 durable/sync units，理论上可能： ```txt O0 committed + locally durable → process crash before O1 ``` restart 后恢复出合法 canonical prefix。Group 的空 Group、Ungroup 的“children 已移出但 Group 尚存在”都必须保持 schema-valid，不能因为 user intent未完成就破坏 recovery correctness。 同样远端 peer 可能先看到 forward prefix，再看到后续/compensation。 INTENT-CRASH-01 — OPEN: 如果产品未来要求 user-intent-level crash atomicity / cross-client atomic visibility，需要 durable local IntentRecoveryRecord、server grouping/commit barrier 或新的 canonical semantic primitive专项设计；不得偷偷把 UndoIntent升级成 Transaction。 # 18. Lifecycle Interruption Baseline 07-14 将 Lifecycle active-session OPEN 收敛为两个不同事件族。 ## 18.1 Interaction interruption Background / explicit Suspend / Canvas detach / destroy / platform pointer cancel 默认进入 interruption barrier： ```txt stop admitting new interaction input → drain already-ordered terminal/commit signals → inspect each active session ├ Operation already accepted into atomic apply → let disposition finish └ otherwise → Cancel / end uncommitted transient state → release pointer capture / transient preview/editor projection → quiesce runtime ``` 不得自动把 preview final frame当 commit。 Text：只有平台已经明确产生 committed edit action并在 barrier 前进入 semantic submit path，才可完成；纯 composing text默认 cancel/drop，不合成 Operation。 ## 18.2 Presentation interruption only Surface Lost / GPU Device Lost 本身只改变 presentation/derived state： - 不自动 cancel semantic session； - 如果 pointer/input capture仍有效，session可以继续，preview可 degrade/fallback； - 如果平台同时报告 pointer capture lost / host detach / input cancel，再按 Interaction interruption cancel； - old surface generation feedback不能反向完成新的 semantic commit。 这保持： ```txt Surface/Device loss != Document loss != Interaction cancel ``` 但平台是否能在具体 surface-loss场景继续提供可靠 pointer/IME input属于 Platform profile。 # 19. Session Interruption Matrix
Session Background / Suspend Surface/Device Loss only
Stroke uncommitted stroke Cancel；已进入 apply 的 AddStroke让其完成 input连续则可继续；input cancel则 Cancel
Eraser discard sweep / candidate / preview；no guessed erase commit 可继续 semantic sweep；preview可重建
Transform Cancel preview transform；canonical stays current input连续则 session可保留；render preview重建
TextEdit end/resync editor projection；uncommitted composition cancel；已 committed edits保留 若 editor host仍有效可继续；host detach则 end/cancel transient
Connector Cancel endpoint/create preview input连续则可继续/rebuild preview
Viewport end gesture；no Document mutation rebind后继续新 viewport interaction
Resume后不恢复旧 uncommitted InteractionSession；从当前 canonical Document / current editor state创建新 session。Process crash更是如此：只有已经进入 canonical + durability path 的事实参与 07-08 recovery。 # 20. Thread / Ordering Contract ```txt Remote/DataBridge or Local Command → Document Ordered Runtime Lane → canonical commit → ChangeSet publication ├→ Scene └→ Interaction conflict notice Input Hot Path / Interaction Executor → transient session updates → final resolve → OperationSubmitPort → Ordered Runtime Lane ``` 规则： - Remote apply 不同步等待 Interaction executor处理 conflict； - Interaction conflict notice按 generation有序消费；若 notice gap/lag不可证明，session在 commit前必须以 current canonical read重新 resolve/preflight； - IntentCommitSegment 只在 Ordered Runtime lane短暂序列化 canonical commits； - preflight/compensation不得等待 Persistence / Sync / Render / Present； - lifecycle barrier停止新 ingress，但不得中断一个已经进入 OperationEngine atomic mutation的 Operation。 # 21. Failure Matrix
Scenario Required behavior
remote unrelated change during Transform Continue；generation变化本身不 cancel
remote deletes transform target Cancel session；no stale SetTransforms
remote changes same transform stale；explicit rebase policy or Cancel；final validation mandatory
remote RichText same object while composing apply remote first；cancel uncommitted composition + resync baseline unless future merge authority
Group preflight O1 invalid zero canonical mutation
Group O0 applied then O1 unexpectedly rejected stop forward sequence；compensate O0 with new canonical op
request-level failure after unknown prefix re-drive same OperationIds to determine Applied/AlreadyApplied/Rejected before compensation
crash between coherent intent Operations recover canonical durable prefix；do not invent hidden rollback；intent-level crash atomicity OPEN
background during active preview no auto commit；cancel unless canonical apply already accepted
surface lost during pointer stream semantic session may continue if input continuity valid；presentation rebuild independently
# 22. Observability 建议最少事件/字段： ```txt interaction.session.begin interaction.session.conflict_notice interaction.session.conflict_action // continue|reresolve|rebase|cancel interaction.session.stale_generation interaction.session.commit_rejected interaction.session.interrupted intent.plan.created intent.preflight.begin/end intent.preflight.rejected intent.segment.begin/end intent.item.disposition intent.compensation.begin/end intent.compensation.failed text.projection.resync lifecycle.interaction_barrier.begin/end ``` Correlation： - InteractionSessionId / IntentId仅 local diagnostics； - canonical correlation使用 OperationId / CanonicalCommitStamp； - 不把 local session/intent IDs塞入 Operation payload。 # 23. Verification / Correctness Oracle 必须覆盖： 1. remote unrelated change during Transform → session持续；final SetTransforms合法。 2. remote delete transform target → session Cancel，Document只有 remote delete。 3. remote same-target transform → 无注册 rebase policy时不得 silent stale commit。 4. remote same RichText edit during no-composition → EditorProjection resync，旧 generation callback被拒。 5. remote same RichText edit during composition → composition不会自动进入 Operation；安全 baseline cancel + resync。 6. Eraser candidate deleted remotely → re-resolve sweep，不生成 stale target delete。 7. Group staged preflight第二步失败 → first Operation未 apply。 8. Group preflight成功，但 injected O1 rejection after O0 → compensation使最终 canonical projection等价 pre-intent（Operation history不同允许）。 9. Ungroup middle failure → placements compensation恢复。 10. Retry unknown multi-op request → same OperationIds使 applied prefix返回 AlreadyApplied，无重复 mutation。 11. coherent segment期间 remote Operation不能 interleave；segment结束后 remote继续正常 apply。 12. crash after durable O0 before O1 → 07-08恢复合法 prefix，不假装 intent原子。 13. background Active Transform/Stroke/Eraser → no guessed canonical commit。 14. background during Text composition → no composing string进入 OpLog/Sync。 15. surface/device loss with surviving input → canonical generation不因 loss变化；session可继续/重建 preview。 16. surface loss + pointer cancel → session cancel，no canonical side effect。 17. final OperationEngine validation必须能拒绝任何 Interaction层漏检的 stale/invalid candidate。 # 24. Resolution Registry
Prior GAP / Question 07-14 Resolution Status
GAP-05 / remote vs active InteractionSession framework已冻结：remote apply不被session阻塞；ChangeSet→footprint→Continue/ReResolve/Rebase/Cancel；final current-state validation。具体 Transform/Text/Connector merge semantics拆为专项 OPEN Resolved — Proposed Freeze framework
